doc.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006

chapter: New Orleans families, lifestyle and retirement
title: Old New Orleans musical families
summary: The Humphreys, Adamses and Bocages, plus M. Red Thompson who played with Hampton.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now did anybody tell you about the Humphrey family in New Orleans? You was asking me about musical families.
The Humphrey family, no. Not specifically.

Nobody told you about the Humphrey family? The Humphrey family was one of them old families. They had a lot of musicians come out of there. The tail end of them, Jamille — he changed his name, he’s got a Muslim name now but his daddy was a Humphrey. His daddy’s mama was a Humphrey. Daddy was a very good trumpet player, he played with Lionel Hampton and played with M. Red Thompson was his name before he got to be Sharif. He played lead with Lionel Hampton and solo. He’s the first person that told me about Clifford Brown and could play all Clifford’s solos. He’s a hell of a trumpet player, his son is still a trumpet player. And he come from Willie Humphrey that’s the Humphrey family, they come out of Willie Humphrey and them. And Willie Humphrey’s brother, what was his name? Percy Humphrey. So that was, the grandfather was a musician out toward everybody in St. James Parish. So that was, I know Clyde done told you about some families, but I’ll put that down. What about the Adams family?

They was from across the river. Justin Adams, Placide Adams, and Mama Dolly Adams, and another brother, they come out of a traditional band setting but in the fifties they was playing modern jazz. And they all went back to playing, even the old lady, playing traditional music, that’s how they could make a living around New Orleans, you know when they made their comeback, they all started playing again. What about the Bocage family? You even heard of a trumpet player named Peter Bocage? Eddie Bocage?
I’ve seen it in the books, yeah.

Yeah there’s another family. I went and got some of them old families ‘cause I know they talk about all the young ones like the Marsalis’ and all of them. But that was three of the old families, along with the Johnson family, I know Clyde talked about him. But that was families that were before.
